Rashi on Niddah 10b:10:1.hebrew: שמעוותות אותן - כלומר, מסרטין לה בצפורן, ומייתו לה לידי ראיה:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:10:1.english: That they distort them - That is to say, they scratch her with a fingernail, and bring her to [the point of] seeing [blood].

Rashi on Niddah 10b:10:2.hebrew: מבפנים - שסיכת שמן מביא הדם, אם זמנו הוא:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:10:2.english: On the inside - For anointing with oil brings out the blood, if it is its time.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:11:1.english: You opened with two - [Namely,] a pregnant woman and a nursing woman.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:1:1.hebrew: מתקיף לה רבי אלעאי - לחזקיה: מה בין זו לבתולה שדמיה טהורין? בתולה שנשאת, יש שדמיה טהורין עד שתחיה המכה, דתלינן בבתולים; ויש שדמיה טהורין ד' לילות; ויש שדמיה טהורין כל לילה הראשונה, כדאמרינן פרק בתרא (לקמן נדה דף סד:). וכולהו קי"ל דכל זמן שדמיה טהורין אין לה כתם, דקתני בפ' האשה (לקמן נדה דף ס.): ושוין שתולה בשומרת יום כנגד יום בראשון שלה ובבתולה שדמיה טהורים. מהתם שמעינן דאין לה כתם, ואע"ג דראתה פעם אחת, דלא מפלגינן בין הגיע זמנה ללא הגיע, בין שראתה פעם אחת בבית אביה, שהיא אחת מן הבתולות שדמיה טהורין. והא הכא, דאילו חזת בשינוי מראה דמיה - מטמאה מעת לעת, דהגיע זמנה לראות וראתה בבית אביה; אפילו הכי, לא מטמאינן כתמה. ומ"ש הך מהא:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:1:1.english: Rabbi Ilai objects to this - [Rabbi Ilai objects] to Ḥizkiyya: What is the difference between this [young girl] and a virgin whose blood is pure? [Regarding] a virgin who married: there are some whose blood is pure until the wound heals, for we attribute [it] to virginity; and there are some whose blood is pure for four nights; and there are some whose blood is pure the entire first night, as we say in the final chapter (below, Niddah 64b). And regarding all of them, it is established for us that as long as her blood is pure, she is not subject to [the impurity of] a stain, as is taught in the chapter [entitled] HaIsha (below, Niddah 60a): And they agree that [a woman] may attribute [a stain] to a woman who observes day for day on her first day, and to a virgin whose blood is pure. From there we learn that she is not subject to [the impurity of] a stain, even though she had seen [blood] once, for we do not differentiate between [whether] her time has arrived or [whether] it has not arrived, or whether she had seen once in her father's house, for she is [nonetheless] one of the virgins whose blood is pure. And behold here, if she were to see with a changed appearance of her blood, she would be defiled for twenty-four hours, since her time to see has arrived and she had seen in her father's house; even so, we do not declare her stain impure. And what is the difference between this [case] and that [case]?

Rashi on Niddah 10b:1:2.hebrew: זו שירפה מצוי - בתולה שדמיה טהורין, שרף שלה מצוי מחמת בתולים. הילכך, כתמה טהור, דתלינן בדם בתולין:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:1:2.english: This one, her discharge is common - [Regarding] a virgin whose blood is pure, her discharge is common due to virginity. Therefore, her stain is pure, as we attribute [it] to hymenal blood.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:1:3.english: And this one, her secretion is not common - [So as] to declare her pure and attribute [the stain] to it.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:2:1.hebrew: רוקה ומדרסה בשוק טהור - כגון שנמצא רוקה בשוק, וקים לן שקודם לכן ראתה ב' פעמים, ואין אנו יודעים אם נדה היא אם לאו, מספיקא לא מחזקינן לה כספק הרוקין, הואיל ולא הוחזקה רואה:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:2:1.english: Her saliva and her trodden object in the marketplace are pure - For example, where her saliva was found in the marketplace, and it is established for us that prior to this she had seen [blood] twice, and we do not know whether she is a nidda or not; out of doubt, we do not treat it as doubtful saliva, since she has not been established as one who sees [blood regularly].

Rashi on Niddah 10b:2:2.hebrew: ולא ידענא כו' - עולא הוא דקאמר: לא ידענא אי א"ר יוחנן מסקנא דהא מילתא, דקאמר כתמה נמי טהור, מדעתיה, או משמיה דר"ש בן יהוצדק, כרוקה ומדרסה:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:2:2.english: And I do not know, etc. - It is Ulla who says: I do not know whether Rabbi Yoḥanan stated the conclusion of this matter, where he said 'her stain is also pure,' from his own opinion, or in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak, like her saliva and her trodden object.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:3:1.hebrew: דבריו של אחד במקום שנים - אי אמר להא, וכתמה נמי טהור, משמיה דרביה, הוי חזקיה, דאמר לעיל טמא, אחד במקום שנים; דהא פליג עליה ר' יוחנן לעיל מלביה, וחזינן דקאי ר"ש כוותיה:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:3:1.english: The words of one in the place of two - If he said this, "and her stain is also pure," in the name of his teacher, [then] Ḥizkiyya, who said above [that it is] impure, is [the opinion of] one against two; for Rabbi Yoḥanan disagreed with him above of his own accord, and we see that Rabbi Shimon stands with him.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:4:1.hebrew: ה"ג אמרו כר"ש בן יהוצדק - בשמו של ר"ש בן יהוצדק, וה"ל חזקיה אחד במקום ב', וש"מ הלכה כר' יוחנן:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:4:1.english: This is the correct version: They stated [it] like Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak - [Meaning] in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak, and [thus] Ḥizkiyya is [the opinion of] one against two, and we learn from this that the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:5:1.hebrew: אינה אלא ראיה אחת - לאחזוקה כרואה, ודיה שעתה עד שתפסוק ותחזור ותראה שתי ראיות:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:5:1.english: It is only one sighting - To establish her [status] as one who sees, and [so] her time suffices for her until she stops and again sees two sightings.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:5:2.english: And it is not necessary [to state if she] stops - And [then] sees again.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:6:1.english: And continuously discharges for all seven [days] - Remove [the word] "even" from here.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:7:2.english: Is not like one who sees - Which implies that it is not even considered like a single sighting.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:7:3.hebrew: אלא כפוסקת - והוו להו ראיות טובא, והוחזקה רואה, ולכשתפסוק ותחזור ותראה, מטמאה מעת לעת:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:7:3.english: Rather, like one who stops - And they are [considered] many sightings, and she is established as one who sees [blood]; and when she stops and sees again, she imparts impurity [retroactively] for a twenty-four-hour period.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:8:1.hebrew: ופרכינן מכלל דשופעת - דאמר לעיל אינה אלא ראיה אחת, היינו דשופעת כי נהרא? בתמיה: כיון דמדלפת אינה חשובה שופעת, וא"א להיות שופעת כמעין כל שבעה וחיה:
Rashi on Niddah 10b:8:1.english: And we object: By implication, [does] one who continuously discharges - Which was stated above [to be] only one sighting, mean that she continuously discharges like a river?! [This is asked] in astonishment: Since dripping is not considered continuously discharging, and it is impossible [for a woman] to continuously discharge like a spring for all seven [days] and live.

Rashi on Niddah 10b:9:1.english: In the presumptive status of ritual impurity - That is to say, under the presumption that [menstrual] blood is commonly found in them.

Tosafot on Niddah 10b:1:1.hebrew: וכי מה בין זו לבתולה שדמיה טהורין - דאם נשתנו מראה דמיה למחרת מראיית שעת תשמיש, טמאה; ואילו מצאה כתם לאחר תשמיש, טהורה, כדאי' בפ' האשה (לקמן נדה דף ס.): תולה בבתולה שדמיה טהורין. ומדלא מפליג, משמע: אפילו הדם משונה, טהור. ומשני: הכא אין שירפה של טהרה מצוי, דאם הכתם בא מגופה, טמאה ודאי; אבל התם, שירפה של טהרה מצוי, לכך טהורה, דאיכא למימר: האי כתם מעלמא בא, ואפילו אי אתא מגופה, איכא למימר דם בתולים הוא (ואיכא למימר) ולא חיתה עדיין המכה:
Tosafot on Niddah 10b:1:1.english: And what is the difference between this [young girl] and a virgin whose blood is pure? - For if the appearance of her blood changed on the morrow from what was seen at the time of intercourse, she is impure; whereas if she found a stain after intercourse, she is pure, as it is stated in the chapter [entitled] HaIsha (below, Niddah 60a): "[She] attributes [a stain] to a virgin whose blood is pure." And since it does not distinguish, it implies [that] even if the blood is altered [in appearance], it is pure. And [the Gemara] answers: Here, her secretion of purity is not common, for if the stain came from her body, she is certainly impure; but there, her secretion of purity is common, therefore she is pure, for one can say [that] this stain came from elsewhere, and even if it came from her body, one can say [that] it is hymeneal blood (and one can say) and the wound has not yet healed.

Tosafot on Niddah 10b:2:1.hebrew: אמר רבי יוחנן משום רבי שמעון בן יהוצדק - משמע שהיה רבו. ובפרק זה בורר (סנהדרין דף כו.) קרי ליה ר"ל לר"ש בן יהוצדק רועי בקר, ולא היה מוחה ר' יוחנן על כבוד רבו? ואומר ר"ת דתרי הוו:
Tosafot on Niddah 10b:2:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan said in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak - This implies that he was his teacher. And in the chapter [entitled] "Zeh Borer" (Sanhedrin 26a), Reish Lakish called Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak [one of the] "cattle herders," and [yet] Rabbi Yochanan did not protest for the honor of his teacher? And Rabbeinu Tam says that there were two [different people by this name].

Tosafot on Niddah 10b:2:2.hebrew: רוקה בשוק טהור - פי' בשוק, שאין ידוע אם ראתה אם לאו, אין להחזיקה כרואה, כיון שלא הגיע זמנה לראות ולא ראתה שלשה פעמים. ומיירי אפילו בבת ע"ה; אבל בבית, ידוע אם ראתה אם לאו:
Tosafot on Niddah 10b:2:2.english: Her saliva in the marketplace is pure - The explanation is: In the marketplace, where it is not known whether she saw [blood] or not, one does not presume her to be one who sees [blood], since her time to see has not arrived and she has not seen three times. And [this] is dealing even with the daughter of an am ha'aretz; but in a house, it is known whether she saw [blood] or not.

Tosafot on Niddah 10b:3:1.hebrew: למהוי דבריו של אחד במקום שנים - וא"ת: ודילמא ר"ש בן יהוצדק סבר לה כרשב"ג, דבג' זימני הוי חזקה, וחזקיה נמי מודה דלרשב"ג כתמה טהור? וי"ל: דרוקה ומדרסה קיל טפי מבכתמה, מדמספקא ליה בכתם אי טמא אם לאו; וכיון דקיל טפי, אי ס"ל כרשב"ג, ה"ל לטהר רוקה ומדרסה עד פעם רביעית:
Tosafot on Niddah 10b:3:1.english: To be the statement of one in the place of two - And if you say: But perhaps Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak holds in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, that a presumption (ḥazakah) is established with three times, and Ḥizkiyya also concedes that according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel her stain is pure? And one can say [in response] that her saliva and her treading [garment] are more lenient than her stain, since [Ulla] was in doubt regarding [her] stain whether it is impure or not; and since [they are] more lenient, if he held in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, he should have ruled her saliva and her treading [garment] pure until the fourth time.

Tosafot on Niddah 10b:9:1.hebrew: הרי הן בחזקת טהרה - וא"ת: במתני' דקתני צריכה להיות בודקת, חוץ מן הנדה כו', אמאי לא מפקא מי שלא הגיע זמנה, וההוא דבנות כותים (לקמן נדה דף לח:), דכל י"א בחזקת טהרה, ומפרש בגמרא לענין שאינה צריכה בדיקה? וי"ל, דלא מפרש במתני' אלא הנהו דאינן צריכים בדיקה מחמת דאין קפידא בראייתם, דנדה בלאו הכי טמאה, ויושבת על דם טוהר, אפילו אם תראה — לעולם טהור; אבל לא הגיע זמנה לראות, וי"א, דאינה צריכה בדיקה מחמת דמסולקין בדמים — לא קתני:
Tosafot on Niddah 10b:9:1.english: They have the presumptive status of ritual purity - And if you say: In the mishna which teaches: "[She] must examine herself, except for the menstruant, etc.", why does it not exclude [a girl] whose time [to see blood] has not arrived, and that which [is taught in the chapter of] 'Banot Kutim' (below, Niddah 38b), that all eleven [days of the zivah period, a woman has] the presumptive status of purity, and the Gemara explains [that this is] with regard to her not needing an examination? And one can say that [the Tanna] in the mishna specifies only those who do not require an examination because there is no concern regarding their seeing [blood] — for a menstruant (niddah) is ritually impure in any case, and a woman sitting on the blood of purity (yoyshevet al dam tohar), even if she sees [blood], it is always pure; but [cases such as a girl whose] time to see [blood] has not arrived, and the eleven [days], where she does not require an examination because their blood is suspended (mesullakin be-damim) — [the mishna] does not teach.
